project.name: return-scanning-app
project.description: Automated return-scanning and marketplace-claims app for Youthnic / VB Exports: marketplace return reports (Myntra, Flipkart, Meesho, Amazon, Ajio) are loaded as lookup data and each physical return is recorded in a permanent scan register, served by an Express/PostgreSQL API with a React web console, a native Android scanner, and a Windows Electron desktop app that automates supplier-panel claims. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: local-secrets.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the local secret protection fallback: tokens round-trip without OS encryption, legacy plaintext and empty values are read safely, and an undecryptable DPAPI value is reported unusable instead of throwing.

nodes.name: meesho-issues.test.ts
nodes.summary: Broad Meesho automation test suite covering issue-code and parcel-condition label mapping, ticket-row parsing, already-filed ticket detection, upload-field mapping and local evidence checks, resolution/rejection extraction, the 23 MB unpacking-video gate, early blocker detection and MeeshoAutomation constructor defaults.

nodes.name: meesho-ticket-page.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests Meesho per-ticket page classification: classifyMeeshoTicketPageText status priorities (rejected over approved, approved over paid, 'not approved' handling, status-chip preference, 200-character cap) and pickLongestTicketText capping.

nodes.name: panel-queue.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the panel-wise continuous claim queue: six isolated supplier panels, marketplace-to-panel key mapping (Myntra EJ vs VB), round-robin rotation that skips busy or held panels, cooldown after three straight failures, and approval holds that do not block other panels.

nodes.name: poll-guard.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the poll-cycle, engine-busy and supplier-profile guards so the worker never overlaps cycles or opens a second browser while a login browser, login test or follow-up check owns the supplier profile.

nodes.name: portal-hold.test.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies holdPortalBrowser and closePortalLoginBrowser manage the held supplier login browser purely through the SupplierBrowserApi adapter surface, using a synthetic fake browser.

nodes.name: bundleWithStubElectron
nodes.summary: Writes an entry file and a stub electron package into a temp dir and bundles it with esbuild as Node CJS, reproducing the packaged desktop bundle shape.

nodes.name: fakeBrowser
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic SupplierBrowserApi implementation with no-op methods and a closed flag so the portal hold/close flow can be tested without a real browser.

nodes.name: TestableMeeshoAutomation
nodes.summary: Test subclass of MeeshoAutomation that exposes the protected evidence map and work directory to verify constructor defaults.

nodes.name: portal-login.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests supplier session profile folders and saved-session markers, isPortalLoggedIn detection for Meesho and generic portals, and secretFromEnvironment credential resolution with alias precedence using synthetic environment values.

nodes.name: agent-client.ts
nodes.summary: HTTP client for the backend agent API: registers the desktop agent, sends heartbeats, leases claim jobs and follow-up tickets, reports progress, completion and follow-up outcomes, files operator tasks and AI run/usage rows, and streams evidence downloads to disk with hash checks and 24-hour pruning. Also defines the JobExecutionBundle and follow-up DTO types.

nodes.name: browser-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Supplier browser adapter that picks the external CDP-driven system Chromium (BrowserRunner) or the native Electron WebContentsView browser and exposes one SupplierBrowserApi surface to marketplace automation, failing loudly instead of silently substituting a profile.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a TypeScript assertion function (asserts runner is ...) for a runtime structural check, and a dynamic import so headless Linux installs never load Electron.

nodes.name: browser-flags.ts
nodes.summary: Pure Chromium sandbox policy that keeps the renderer sandbox on for untrusted supplier pages and emits --no-sandbox only when BROWSER_NO_SANDBOX is truthy or the engine runs as root on Linux.

nodes.name: browser-runner.ts
nodes.summary: CDP-driven system browser runner: finds Chrome/Edge/Chromium, launches it with a per-panel profile and debug port, drives pages over a WebSocket (navigation, evaluation, screenshots, human-like typing and clicking, file uploads, CAPTCHA/OTP detection) and kills the whole browser process tree on close.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Loads and saves the desktop agent configuration (backend URL, API key, poll/heartbeat/follow-up intervals, browser mode and work directories) in the agent data dir, protecting the API key with local OS secret storage and only accepting trusted backend origins.

nodes.name: cors.ts
nodes.summary: Exact-allowlist CORS policy for the engine HTTP API: only returnapp://desktop, the Vite dev origins in development, and normalized ENGINE_CORS_ORIGINS extras are allowed; the allow-origin is never '*' and never reflects an arbitrary origin.

nodes.name: crash-guard.ts
nodes.summary: Process-level crash guards for the 24/7 engine: unhandled rejections are logged and filing continues, uncaught exceptions are logged synchronously and exit non-zero so the supervisor restarts a clean process, and EPIPE on stdout/stderr is ignored.

nodes.name: AgentBackendClient
nodes.summary: Backend API client for the desktop agent: registration and heartbeat, job and follow-up leasing, progress/completion/follow-up reporting, operator tasks, AI procedure and usage reporting, execution bundle fetch, and hash-verified streamed evidence download with cleanup and 24-hour pruning.

nodes.name: defaultAdapterKind
nodes.summary: Returns the default adapter kind: native when bundled Chromium is available, external otherwise.

nodes.name: resolveBrowserAdapterKind
nodes.summary: Resolves the browser adapter from BROWSER_ADAPTER (native, external, auto), warning on unknown values and falling back to the shell-based default.

nodes.name: nativeBrowserAvailable
nodes.summary: Reports whether the process is running inside the Electron shell, i.e. bundled Chromium is available.

nodes.name: assertBrowserRunnerSurface
nodes.summary: Assertion function that verifies a BrowserRunner exposes every SupplierBrowserApi method and throws listing any missing ones.

nodes.name: openExternalBrowser
nodes.summary: Launches the system Chromium through BrowserRunner with the panel profile, connects to its page over CDP and returns an external adapter handle.

nodes.name: openNativeBrowser
nodes.summary: Opens the Electron WebContentsView supplier browser via a dynamic import, throwing a clear error when not running in the desktop shell.

nodes.name: openSupplierBrowser
nodes.summary: Public entry that opens a supplier browser through the configured adapter, never silently substituting the external adapter for a native request.

nodes.name: describeBrowserAdapter
nodes.summary: Returns a human-readable adapter description for engine diagnostics and the dashboard.

nodes.name: isNoSandboxRequested
nodes.summary: Parses BROWSER_NO_SANDBOX, treating only 1, true or yes (case-insensitive) as an opt-in.

nodes.name: shouldDisableBrowserSandbox
nodes.summary: Decides whether the Chromium sandbox must be disabled: explicit opt-in, or root on Linux.

nodes.name: browserSandboxArgs
nodes.summary: Returns the sandbox command-line flags to append, ['--no-sandbox'] only when the policy requires it.

nodes.name: currentBrowserSandboxState
nodes.summary: Reads platform, root status and the BROWSER_NO_SANDBOX opt-in from the current process.

nodes.name: whichBinaries
nodes.summary: Looks up the first of several executable names on PATH using where (Windows) or command -v (POSIX).

nodes.name: findSystemBrowser
nodes.summary: Locates an installed Chromium-family browser, honouring BROWSER_PATH first, then PATH lookups and fixed per-OS install locations.

nodes.name: BrowserRunner
nodes.summary: CDP WebSocket driver for a system Chromium process: launch with profile and debug port, navigation, evaluation, screenshots, CAPTCHA/OTP detection, human-like typing and clicks, label clicking, file chooser uploads and process-tree teardown (taskkill /T /F or process-group kill).

nodes.name: pickIntervalMs
nodes.summary: Picks the first finite millisecond interval at or above a minimum from candidate values, falling back to a default so blank or invalid env values cannot create a tight loop.

nodes.name: isTrustedBackendUrl
nodes.summary: Checks whether a URL's origin matches the production backend or the configured BACKEND_URL/APP_URL origins.

nodes.name: loadAgentConfig
nodes.summary: Loads config.json from the agent data dir, merges environment overrides, validates intervals and the backend URL, decrypts the stored API key and re-saves it protected.

nodes.name: saveAgentConfig
nodes.summary: Merges updates into the agent config, rejects untrusted backend URLs, syncs process.env.BACKEND_URL and writes the config as a secret file with the API key encrypted.

nodes.name: normalizeOriginEntry
nodes.summary: Normalizes one ENGINE_CORS_ORIGINS entry to an exact http(s) origin, rejecting wildcards, paths, queries and non-http schemes.

nodes.name: corsAllowedOrigin
nodes.summary: Returns the single allowed origin for a request (renderer, dev or configured extra) or null so non-allowed and non-CORS requests get no CORS headers.

nodes.name: corsHeadersFor
nodes.summary: Builds the pinned CORS response headers for an allowed origin, with credentials disabled and Vary: Origin.

nodes.name: installCrashGuards
nodes.summary: Installs process-wide handlers once: continue on unhandled rejections, log and exit (or call onFatal) on uncaught exceptions, and ignore EPIPE stream errors.

nodes.name: resetCrashGuards
nodes.summary: Test-only reset that forgets the crash guards were installed.

nodes.name: cycle-watchdog.ts
nodes.summary: Per-cycle watchdog that races each engine poll (20 min) or follow-up (8 min) cycle against a hard timeout, returning a CYCLE_TIMEOUT sentinel and firing a reset callback so a hung network await can no longer silence both worker loops.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a `unique symbol` sentinel so a timeout result can never collide with a real cycle value, and unref()s the timer so it never keeps the process alive.

nodes.name: desktop-app-server.ts
nodes.summary: The automation engine entry point: owns the only claim-filing poll loop and the only ticket follow-up loop (guarded by poll-guard and cycle watchdogs), runs marketplace automation in supplier browsers, performs AI-assisted follow-up recovery, and serves the engine HTTP API, SSE logs, evidence routes and the legacy dashboard HTML behind CORS and bearer-token gating.
nodes.languageNotes: A ~4,400-line module with module-level mutable state (in-flight flags, timers, cycle generation counter) coordinating two setTimeout-chained loops; the dashboard UI is an inline template-literal HTML string.

nodes.name: engine-config.ts
nodes.summary: Fail-closed engine bind policy: a loopback bind runs token-free while any reachable bind requires an ENGINE_TOKEN of at least 24 characters; also provides constant-time token comparison, bearer header parsing, IPv6/wildcard-aware client URLs, insecure remote URL detection and exact-origin checks.

nodes.name: evidence-files.ts
nodes.summary: Local evidence-file helpers backing the engine's GET /api/evidence routes: strict claim id validation, path-traversal-safe resolution inside the claim directory, file listing and content-type/disposition stream headers, all working while the backend is down.

nodes.name: follow-up-bundle.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the minimal JobExecutionBundle for a follow-up ticket status check (no evidence, no credentials, placeholder claim fields) so the worker never invents a bundle at the call site.

nodes.name: withCycleTimeout
nodes.summary: Races a cycle promise against a hard timeout, resolving with the body value or the CYCLE_TIMEOUT sentinel after calling onTimeout once; never throws for late settlements and never leaks the timer.

nodes.name: ensureViewForManualShow
nodes.summary: Ensures a manually requested supplier tab has a real WebContentsView before it is shown, refusing while the worker or a login test owns the profile.

nodes.name: pollAndProcessJob
nodes.summary: One claim-filing cycle: checks the poll guard, leases a job, picks the panel, downloads evidence, opens the supplier browser, runs the marketplace automation with submit-safety checks, reports progress or completion and tears the browser down, all under the cycle watchdog.

nodes.name: assistClientHooks
nodes.summary: Builds the backend hooks used by the follow-up assistance pass: approved procedure refresh and operator task filing.

nodes.name: runFollowUpAssist
nodes.summary: Advisory assistance pass after a follow-up check: tries an approved memory procedure, then a bounded AI proposal, then files an operator review task; never changes reported results or executes marketplace actions.

nodes.name: pollAndProcessFollowUp
nodes.summary: One ticket follow-up cycle: leases a follow-up, checks the saved supplier session, opens the panel browser and calls the marketplace checkClaimStatus(), reports the outcome and runs the assistance pass, guarded by the nightly window and the cycle watchdog.

nodes.name: scheduleNextFollowUp
nodes.summary: Schedules the next follow-up check on its own timer chain, rescheduling at the configured interval while the worker is running.

nodes.name: pollDelayMs
nodes.summary: Computes the adaptive poll cadence: faster while claims flow, backing off to 2x and 3x the interval while the queue stays empty.

nodes.name: scheduleNextPoll
nodes.summary: Schedules the next filing poll cycle, keeping the poll timer alive for the chain's lifetime and using the adaptive delay.

nodes.name: engineRunOnceNow
nodes.summary: Serialized one-shot 'Poll Now' that runs a filing cycle even while paused, chained so manual requests never overlap.

nodes.name: startScheduler
nodes.summary: Starts the filing poll chain and the separate follow-up chain, with the first follow-up look-up about 10 seconds after start.

nodes.name: getDashboardHtml
nodes.summary: Returns the engine's server-rendered dashboard as one large inline HTML/CSS/JS template, used only in headless Linux mode.

nodes.name: readJson
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a JSON request body from an incoming HTTP request.

nodes.name: portalBrowserSnapshot
nodes.summary: Builds the multi-tab supplier browser snapshot (tabs, active tab, held/claim reason) while keeping legacy top-level fields for older callers.

nodes.name: beginClaimWork
nodes.summary: Marks the operator signed in, registers the agent, recovers interrupted AI Center activity and starts the scheduler.

nodes.name: resumeClaimBotIfSignedIn
nodes.summary: Resumes the 24/7 claim bot at startup when a saved Admin or Supervisor operator session exists.

nodes.name: engineStatus
nodes.summary: Returns the engine status snapshot: worker state, poll and follow-up stats, active job, browser adapter, AI assist usage and nightly window.

nodes.name: engineStart
nodes.summary: Resumes the worker and restarts the scheduler.

nodes.name: enginePause
nodes.summary: Pauses the worker loops.

nodes.name: engineSetBackendUrl
nodes.summary: Persists a new backend URL and recreates the backend client.

nodes.name: engineBindInfo
nodes.summary: Returns the resolved engine bind (host, port, mode) or null before the server starts.

nodes.name: startDesktopAppServer
nodes.summary: Starts the engine HTTP server: installs crash guards, applies CORS and bearer-token gating, and routes operator auth, engine control, evidence streaming, SSE logs, AI Center/memory, portal logins, supplier tab management, panel holds and settings.

nodes.name: launchAppWindow
nodes.summary: Opens the engine URL in a system Chromium --app window when one is installed.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Command-line entry: resolves the bind, starts the server, resumes the claim bot and opens an app window in local, non-headless mode.

nodes.name: isLoopbackHost
nodes.summary: Checks whether a host string is a loopback spelling (127.x, ::1, localhost).

nodes.name: parseEnginePort
nodes.summary: Validates ENGINE_PORT as an integer TCP port, throwing on invalid input instead of guessing.

nodes.name: resolveEngineBind
nodes.summary: Resolves host, port, mode and auth token from the environment, refusing a non-loopback bind without an ENGINE_TOKEN of the minimum length.

nodes.name: engineTokenMatches
nodes.summary: Compares a presented bearer token with the expected one in constant time; an empty expected token means no auth.

nodes.name: bearerTokenFromHeader
nodes.summary: Extracts a bearer token from an Authorization header value.

nodes.name: clientHostForBind
nodes.summary: Maps wildcard bind hosts (0.0.0.0, ::) to the matching loopback address a client can dial.

nodes.name: localEngineUrl
nodes.summary: Builds the client URL for the engine bind, bracketing IPv6 literals and dialling wildcards at loopback.

nodes.name: isInsecureRemoteUrl
nodes.summary: Flags a plain-http, non-loopback engine URL so the engine token never crosses the network in clear text.

nodes.name: isSameOrigin
nodes.summary: Exact-origin comparison used to keep the app window on the engine origin.

nodes.name: isValidEvidenceClaimId
nodes.summary: Validates an evidence claim id against the strict alphanumeric pattern with no path characters.

nodes.name: resolveEvidenceFile
nodes.summary: Resolves a URL-supplied file name to a path inside the claim directory, returning null for traversal, absolute paths, separators, NUL, empty or oversized names.

nodes.name: listEvidenceFiles
nodes.summary: Lists top-level evidence files for a claim sorted by name with size and mtime, skipping .part downloads and directories.

nodes.name: evidenceContentType
nodes.summary: Maps an evidence file extension to its MIME content type.

nodes.name: evidenceDisposition
nodes.summary: Chooses inline disposition for images and video and attachment for everything else.

nodes.name: evidenceStreamHeaders
nodes.summary: Builds Content-Type, Content-Length and Content-Disposition headers for streaming an evidence file.

nodes.name: followUpExecutionBundle
nodes.summary: Returns a JobExecutionBundle for a follow-up check with stage follow_up, empty credentials, placeholder claim fields and no evidence.

nodes.name: load-env.ts
nodes.summary: Side-effect module that loads .env files from the working directory and from AGENT_DATA_DIR for the desktop engine, while preserving process-environment precedence for the backend URL and the Meesho credential alias groups.
nodes.languageNotes: Snapshotting process.env keys at import time lets later code distinguish externally supplied variables from ones dotenv loaded from a file.

nodes.name: local-secrets.ts
nodes.summary: Encrypts and decrypts desktop-agent secrets (operator session token, per-PC API key) with Electron safeStorage, i.e. DPAPI on Windows, and falls back to the legacy plaintext format when no OS credential store is available.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses createRequire with a __filename / import.meta.url fallback so `electron` resolves both inside the esbuild CJS bundle and under tsx ESM.

nodes.name: logger.ts
nodes.summary: Engine-wide logger singleton that writes level-tagged lines to the console and to daily bot-YYYY-MM-DD.log files under the agent data directory (pruning old days), keeps a recent-log buffer and subscribers for the dashboard, and offers a synchronous fatal path for crash guards.

nodes.name: ajio.ts
nodes.summary: Assisted Ajio supplier-portal claim automation that opens the returns portal, stops for CAPTCHA/2FA, captures prepare/submit screenshots, and hands filing back to the operator because no ticket number is read yet.

nodes.name: amazon.ts
nodes.summary: Assisted Amazon Seller Central claim automation that opens the portal, stops for CAPTCHA/OTP challenges, captures screenshots, and asks the operator to finish filing since no case ID is captured.

nodes.name: base-automation.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract BaseMarketplaceAutomation contract and the result types for claim filing and ticket-status checks, plus shared human-like typing, clicking, waiting and file-upload helpers over the supplier browser API.

nodes.name: flipkart.ts
nodes.summary: Assisted Flipkart seller-portal claim automation that navigates to returns, handles challenges and sign-in prompts, clicks Submit when allowed, and falls back to manual completion when no ticket number appears.

nodes.name: meesho.ts
nodes.summary: Fully automatic Meesho supplier-panel claim filer and ticket-status reader: maps claim issues and packet states to portal labels, detects existing tickets and eligibility blockers, validates and uploads evidence files and video, submits the Raise a Ticket form, and classifies per-ticket page text for follow-ups.
nodes.languageNotes: Most parsing logic (label resolution, ticket-row parsing, page-text classification) is exported as pure browser-free functions so node:test fixtures can cover portal parsing without launching Chromium.

nodes.name: isBackendUrlExternallyControlled
nodes.summary: Reports whether BACKEND_URL or APP_URL was set in the real process environment before any .env file loaded, so runtime settings cannot override a fixed deployment.

nodes.name: electronSafeStorage
nodes.summary: Lazily resolves Electron's safeStorage API and returns it only when OS-level encryption is available; returns null outside Electron.

nodes.name: localEncryptionAvailable
nodes.summary: Returns true when OS-backed encryption such as Windows DPAPI is usable, so the dashboard can report the active secret-storage mode.

nodes.name: protectSecret
nodes.summary: Encrypts a plaintext secret into the dpapi:<base64> storage format, leaving already-encrypted values untouched and falling back to plaintext with a warning when encryption fails.

nodes.name: revealSecret
nodes.summary: Decrypts a dpapi:-prefixed stored secret back to plaintext, passing legacy plaintext values through so older files stay readable.

nodes.name: writeLogLine
nodes.summary: Appends a log line to the day's bot log file after ensuring the owner-only data directory exists, and prunes log files older than the retention window once per day.

nodes.name: AgentLogger
nodes.summary: Prefixed logger with debug/info/warn/error levels, log subscribers, an in-memory recent-log buffer for the dashboard, and fatalSync which writes to disk synchronously before an immediate process exit.

nodes.name: AjioAutomation
nodes.summary: Ajio automation that navigates to the supplier returns portal, returns manual_intervention_required on CAPTCHA/2FA, returns prepared when approval is required, and otherwise asks the operator to finish because no ticket ID is captured.

nodes.name: AmazonAutomation
nodes.summary: Amazon Seller Central automation that navigates to the portal, stops on CAPTCHA/OTP, returns prepared when approval is required, and otherwise requests manual completion because no case ID is captured.

nodes.name: BaseMarketplaceAutomation
nodes.summary: Abstract base for per-marketplace claim automations: holds the supplier browser, job bundle, evidence files and work dir, requires execute(prepare|submit), and defaults checkClaimStatus to not-supported so follow-ups stop for marketplaces without a status reader.

nodes.name: FlipkartAutomation
nodes.summary: Flipkart automation that opens the returns dashboard, handles challenges and sign-in prompts, stops at prepared when approval is required, clicks Submit otherwise, and requests manual completion when no ticket number appears.

nodes.name: resolveMeeshoIssueLabel
nodes.summary: Maps a claim issue code to its verified Meesho Raise a Ticket category label, or null so an unmapped issue stops for human review instead of a wrong claim type.

nodes.name: resolveMeeshoPacketLabel
nodes.summary: Returns the portal State of the packet choice (Intact or Tampered) for a verified shipment condition, or null when the condition is missing or unverified.

nodes.name: findExistingTicketForOrder
nodes.summary: Scans support-table rows for a ticket already filed against one of the claim's order references, ignoring IDs that are themselves order or AWB numbers, to prevent duplicate filing.

nodes.name: parseMeeshoTicketRow
nodes.summary: Matches a Support ticket-table row to a ticket reference and returns its status text, plus a normalized hint only for unambiguous paid, rejected or approved wording.

nodes.name: extractMeeshoResolution
nodes.summary: Extracts an approved amount or a rejection reason from Meesho ticket detail text, resolution banners or the support conversation timeline.

nodes.name: classifyMeeshoTicketPageText
nodes.summary: Classifies a per-ticket page's text into a status line and normalized state in two passes (short status-chip lines first, then all lines), returning nothing for unmatched text.

nodes.name: pickLongestTicketText
nodes.summary: Picks the longest non-empty candidate element text, capped at TICKET_PAGE_TEXT_MAX_CHARS, mirroring the legacy Python tracker's longest-scoped-text rule.

nodes.name: resolveMeeshoUploadField
nodes.summary: Maps a Meesho file-input element id to the evidence field it accepts.

nodes.name: summarizeMeeshoUploadFailures
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable summary of failed upload boxes, naming the exact field and status, for the claim panel.

nodes.name: checkMeeshoEvidenceFileLocal
nodes.summary: Local pre-flight check that an evidence file exists, is non-empty and has an accepted MIME type by extension.

nodes.name: validateMeeshoVideoForUpload
nodes.summary: Returns true only when the unboxing video satisfies the portal's .mp4 and roughly 23 MB size rule.

nodes.name: detectMeeshoEarlyBlocker
nodes.summary: Returns the first visible portal message that blocks filing, or null when there is none.

nodes.name: MeeshoAutomation
nodes.summary: Drives the Meesho supplier panel end to end: ensures sign-in, checks for existing tickets and early blockers, fills the ticket form with issue and packet labels, uploads validated evidence, submits, and implements checkClaimStatus through the per-ticket deep link with a ticket-table fallback.

nodes.name: myntra.ts
nodes.summary: Assisted Myntra partner-portal claim automation that opens the returns portal, stops for CAPTCHA/2FA, captures screenshots, and asks the operator to finish filing since no ticket number is read.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: Marketplace automation factory that maps a marketplace name to its automation class (Meesho, Flipkart, Amazon, Myntra, Ajio) and reports whether a marketplace has automation support.

nodes.name: native-browser-view.ts
nodes.summary: Native supplier browser for the desktop app built on Electron WebContentsView: gives each marketplace panel an isolated persistent partition, manages a tab registry with detach/dock windows, workspace-rect layout and focus discipline, and implements the SupplierBrowserApi used by marketplace automations.
nodes.languageNotes: Electron is imported dynamically only inside the open path, so the module stays import-safe on headless Linux and in node:test; a per-panel promise mutex prevents two views attaching to one partition.

nodes.name: operator-session.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the desktop operator's backend sign-in: stores the bearer token encrypted in an owner-only session file, validates it against the backend profile endpoint, and provides authorized fetch, login and logout helpers.

nodes.name: panel-queue.ts
nodes.summary: Panel-wise continuous claim queue that keeps in-memory runtime state per marketplace panel (busy, held, cooling down) and gives the worker a round-robin order so one stuck panel never blocks the others.

nodes.name: poll-guard.ts
nodes.summary: Pure guard functions for the engine worker loop that decide when a poll cycle may run and whether the shared supplier browser profile is in use, so cycles, login tests and held login browsers never overlap.

nodes.name: portal-login.ts
nodes.summary: Supplier-portal login orchestration for the desktop engine: lists configured panel logins, resolves credentials from typed, admin, job-bundle or environment sources, opens the supplier browser to sign in, verifies the authenticated state, writes session markers, and requeues jobs.

nodes.name: submit-guard.ts
nodes.summary: Fail-closed pre-submit gate that re-validates a freshly fetched job execution bundle just before the engine clicks Submit, blocking stale, finished, re-queued or already-resolved claims and requiring the backend submitting lease for approval accounts.

nodes.name: MyntraAutomation
nodes.summary: Myntra partner-portal automation that navigates to returns, stops on CAPTCHA/2FA, returns prepared when approval is required, and otherwise asks the operator to finish because no ticket number is read.

nodes.name: isMarketplaceSupported
nodes.summary: Returns true when the marketplace name matches a supported automation key, letting callers skip opening a browser for unknown panels.

nodes.name: getAutomationEngine
nodes.summary: Instantiates the matching marketplace automation for a job with its browser, evidence files and work dir, throwing for marketplaces that require assisted manual filing.

nodes.name: configureSupplierSessionHeaders
nodes.summary: Injects a genuine Chrome user agent and sec-ch-ua client hints into a supplier session's request headers so anti-bot WAFs (e.g. Akamai on Meesho) do not flag the embedded browser.

nodes.name: withPanelLock
nodes.summary: Per-panel async mutex that serializes browser opens so two callers can never attach two views to one partition.

nodes.name: setBrowserWorkspaceRect
nodes.summary: Sets the dashboard workspace rectangle that confines supplier views and re-lays out or hides views accordingly; null hides every view.

nodes.name: getBrowserWorkspaceRect
nodes.summary: Returns the active dashboard workspace rectangle, if one is set.

nodes.name: isFullscreenSupplierView
nodes.summary: Reports whether the operator explicitly expanded the supplier view to fullscreen.

nodes.name: setFullscreenSupplierView
nodes.summary: Enters or exits explicit fullscreen mode and re-fits the visible supplier views.

nodes.name: supplierViewBounds
nodes.summary: Computes visible supplier-view bounds by clamping the workspace rect into the window, returning null (hide) when the Browsers tab is inactive or the rect is under 120x120 unless fullscreen is active.

nodes.name: notifyWindowGeometryChanged
nodes.summary: Re-fits or hides supplier views after a window resize, move, maximize or display-metrics change.

nodes.name: setSupplierViewHost
nodes.summary: Registers or clears the main-window host that the Electron shell provides for attaching supplier views.

nodes.name: setDetachedViewHost
nodes.summary: Registers or clears the shell's detached-window host used for popped-out supplier tabs.

nodes.name: isSupplierTabDetached
nodes.summary: Reports whether a panel's tab currently lives in the detached secondary window.

nodes.name: detachSupplierTab
nodes.summary: Moves a tab's live WebContentsView, with any open OTP/CAPTCHA popups, into a dedicated detached window while keeping cookies, DOM state and the worker lease.

nodes.name: focusDetachedSupplierTab
nodes.summary: Focuses the detached secondary window for a tab without touching the main window.

nodes.name: dockSupplierTab
nodes.summary: Moves a detached tab's live view back into the main window's bounded viewport before the secondary window closes, so the session survives.

nodes.name: handleDetachedWindowClosed
nodes.summary: Docks a tab first when its detached window is closing, preserving the session.

nodes.name: disposeDetachedSupplierViews
nodes.summary: On clean quit, destroys every detached window and hides every main-window supplier view, returning the affected panels.

nodes.name: notifyWindowLifecycle
nodes.summary: Handles minimize, restore, tray-hide and quit transitions so tab sessions and worker leases survive, bounds are re-synced and detached windows are disposed on quit.

nodes.name: attachSupplierViewForBackground
nodes.summary: Attaches a panel's view for background worker steps (claim preparation, follow-ups, status polls) without showing or focusing the OS window.

nodes.name: showSupplierViewForUser
nodes.summary: User-initiated show of a panel's tab that focuses the window only when the caller passes focus: true.

nodes.name: resolveStoredPanelKey
nodes.summary: Resolves a tab id, exact key or normalized key to the stored panel key without renaming the stored entry.

nodes.name: tabIdForPanelKey
nodes.summary: Derives the deterministic tab id for a supplier panel key, giving one isolated tab per panel.

nodes.name: labelForPanelKey
nodes.summary: Returns the display label (Meesho, Myntra VB and so on) for a panel key.

nodes.name: viewMetadata
nodes.summary: Reads live navigation metadata (URL, title, loading, back/forward availability) from a WebContentsView, tolerating destroyed views.

nodes.name: metadataFor

nodes.name: fitDetachedView

nodes.name: removeDetachedWindow

nodes.summary: Creates the system tray icon and menu for opening the window, toggling the bot, checking claims now and quitting.

nodes.summary: Mock-fetch test suite for the AI provider catalog and adapters: catalog versioning, HTTP error classification, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini transport parsing, structured output validation, timeouts, retries, fallback, cost estimation, and model discovery.

nodes.name: html-escape.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for HTML entity escaping and inline-script-safe JavaScript literals, including script-element breakout attempts and Unicode line separators.

nodes.summary: Test fixture that builds a local AI memory containing a procedure with injected HTML/script markup to exercise escaping.

nodes.name: ai-assistant.ts

nodes.name: ai-center-assist.ts
nodes.summary: AI Center routed-assistance pipeline (M6) that picks provider candidates via the router, calls models with sanitized diagnostic prompts, validates proposals, records usage/cost/activity, pushes RTDB signals, and degrades to operator review on budget blocks or outages.

nodes.name: ai-center-routes.ts
nodes.summary: Engine HTTP route handler for /api/v1/ai-center: serves the provider catalog, provider key/prefs/test/model-discovery actions, routing config, usage summaries and activity, gated on operator sign-in and never returning key material.

nodes.name: ai-center-store.ts
nodes.summary: File-backed AI Center local state: per-task routing config (ai-routing.json), an append-only activity ledger with restart recovery (ai-activity.jsonl), and a capped pending-sync queue (ai-pending-sync.json).

nodes.name: ai-firebase.ts
nodes.summary: Best-effort Firebase Realtime Database notifier that pushes minimal sync signals (type, time, opaque ref) to other operator PCs, failing open when unconfigured and flagging sensitive values that must never be sent.

nodes.name: ai-memory-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Engine-local mirror of server-approved AI recovery procedures and recent execution events stored in ai-memory.json, with TTL staleness checks, approved-only lookup, upsert, event capping and 24h pruning.

nodes.name: ai-memory-panel.ts
nodes.summary: Shapes the local AI memory cache into the HTML-escaped dashboard payload for GET /api/v1/ai-memory and provides a local kill-switch that disables a cached procedure.

nodes.name: loadAiAssistConfig
nodes.summary: Parses AI assistance settings from environment variables (enabled flag, gateway URL/token, model, call cap, timeout) with safe defaults that keep AI off.

nodes.name: aiUsageSnapshot
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the metadata-only AI usage ledger (calls, failures, latency, model, last usage).

nodes.name: resetAiUsageForTests
nodes.summary: Resets the in-memory AI usage ledger counters; used to isolate tests.

nodes.name: GatewayProvider
nodes.summary: Authenticated AI gateway provider that POSTs prompts to AI_GATEWAY_URL with a bearer token, enforces a timeout, and records call metadata in the usage ledger.

nodes.name: providerFromConfig
nodes.summary: Factory returning a GatewayProvider when AI is enabled and gateway URL/token are set, otherwise null.

nodes.name: validateAiProposal
nodes.summary: Type guard that accepts an AI proposal only if its kind is in the safe allowlist, its summary is non-empty and bounded, and any ticket reference matches the known ticket.

nodes.name: requestAiProposal
nodes.summary: Calls an AI provider with bounded retries (max 3), never throwing; returns text plus provider usage or null so callers degrade to human review.

nodes.name: decideFollowUpAssist
nodes.summary: Memory-first decision for a follow-up check: no action for unchanged or unsupported tickets, then approved procedure, then AI if enabled, else human review.

nodes.name: buildDiagnosticPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the sanitized diagnostic prompt (marketplace, claim, ticket, step, error signature, short note) sent to models, never including credentials or HTML.

nodes.name: honestCost
nodes.summary: Estimates cost from real provider token counts only, returning an Unknown provenance instead of $0.00 when no counts were reported.

nodes.name: runRoutedAssist
nodes.summary: Runs one routed AI assistance attempt: loads routing, gathers provider health and monthly spend, decides candidates, calls models with retries, validates the draft, records usage/activity/success or errors, notifies RTDB, and falls back to filing an operator task.

nodes.name: testProviderConnection
nodes.summary: UI Test Connection path that makes a genuine low-cost model call with the stored key, records usage and success, or categorizes and records the error.

nodes.name: resolveTestModel
nodes.summary: Resolves the Test Connection model from body, saved preference, then catalog default, trimming each so whitespace-only values fall through.

nodes.name: handleAiCenterRoute
nodes.summary: Dispatches all /api/v1/ai-center requests (catalog, providers, key save/delete, test incl. SDK mode, model discovery, prefs, routing, usage, activity) after enforcing operator sign-in.

nodes.name: loadRoutingConfig
nodes.summary: Reads and normalizes ai-routing.json, falling back to the default routing config when missing or corrupt.

nodes.name: saveRoutingConfig
nodes.summary: Normalizes and atomically writes the routing config via a temp file rename.

nodes.name: appendActivity
nodes.summary: Appends one agent activity entry as a JSON line to ai-activity.jsonl.

nodes.name: readActivity
nodes.summary: Reads the newest activity entries from the JSONL ledger, skipping corrupt lines, newest first.

nodes.name: recoverInterruptedActivity
nodes.summary: Marks activity entries that started but never ended as interrupted after a restart and rewrites the ledger.

nodes.name: readPendingSync
nodes.summary: Reads the pending Postgres/RTDB sync queue, returning an empty list on any error.

nodes.name: queuePendingSync
nodes.summary: Appends a bounded pending-sync record and keeps only the newest 200 entries.

nodes.name: loadRtdbConfig
nodes.summary: Reads the Firebase RTDB URL and auth token from the environment, returning null when unconfigured.

nodes.name: pushSignal
nodes.summary: Best-effort PUT of a truncated sync signal to Firebase RTDB with a timeout, resolving false instead of throwing when unconfigured or offline.

nodes.name: isSensitiveForRtdb
nodes.summary: Flags strings that look like keys, tokens, passwords, cookies, OTPs or captchas so they are never sent to RTDB.

nodes.name: isCacheStale
nodes.summary: Returns true when the memory mirror never synced or its last sync is older than the TTL.

nodes.name: markSynced
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the memory stamped with a new syncedAt timestamp.

nodes.name: emptyLocalMemory
nodes.summary: Creates an empty version-1 local AI memory structure.

nodes.name: loadLocalMemory
nodes.summary: Loads ai-memory.json, filtering out malformed procedures and events and returning empty memory on any error.

nodes.name: saveLocalMemory
nodes.summary: Atomically writes the local AI memory to disk through a temp file rename.

nodes.name: findApprovedProcedure
nodes.summary: Case-insensitive lookup of an approved (never pending or disabled) procedure by marketplace and error signature.

nodes.name: upsertCachedProcedure
nodes.summary: Returns memory with a procedure inserted or replaced by id.

nodes.name: recordLocalEvent
nodes.summary: Appends an execution event, keeping only the newest LOCAL_EVENT_CAP entries.

nodes.name: pruneLocalEvents
nodes.summary: Drops cached events older than 24 hours.

nodes.name: buildAiMemoryPayload
nodes.summary: Builds the AI memory dashboard payload with HTML-escaped procedure fields, the newest 20 events, usage snapshot and assist flag.

nodes.name: disableLocalProcedure
nodes.summary: Local kill-switch that flips a cached procedure to disabled and reports whether it was found and changed.

nodes.name: ai-provider-store.ts
nodes.summary: AI Center provider credential and preference store: DPAPI/OS-store encrypted API keys in ai-providers.json (fail-closed without encryption) and separate per-provider prefs with last success/error tracking.

nodes.name: ai-providers.ts
nodes.summary: Versioned catalog of six LLM providers plus direct-HTTPS adapters (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic messages, Gemini generateContent) with typed error classification, timeouts, bounded retries, fallback, model discovery, structured output, and cost estimation.
nodes.languageNotes: ProviderError extends Error with a typed `category` union and a derived `retryable` flag; adapters take an injectable `fetchFn` so the core stays mock-testable.

nodes.name: ai-routing.ts
nodes.summary: Pure AI Center model-routing logic: task kinds and labels, default and normalized per-task routes, and a cost-aware decideRoute that respects manual pins, key health, monthly budgets and escalation.

nodes.name: ai-sdk-bridge.ts
nodes.summary: Vercel AI SDK Core bridge that builds @ai-sdk/openai, anthropic or google models from stored provider credentials and runs generateText, used for SDK-mode Test Connection verification.

nodes.name: ai-usage-store.ts
nodes.summary: Durable append-only AI usage ledger (ai-usage.jsonl) recording provider-reported tokens, latency and cost with pricing provenance, plus aggregation by provider/model/task and current-month spend.

nodes.name: html-escape.ts
nodes.summary: Pure escaping helpers for engine- and shell-rendered HTML: entity escaping for text/attributes and inline-script-safe JSON literals that cannot close a script element.

nodes.name: paths.ts
nodes.summary: Engine state path helpers resolving the AGENT_DATA_DIR root (or a home-folder default), creating it owner-only, and writing secret files with 0700/0600 permissions tightened on every call.

nodes.name: plaintextAllowed
nodes.summary: Returns true only when AI_CENTER_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT=1 permits unencrypted key storage for dev/test.

nodes.name: saveProviderKey
nodes.summary: Encrypts and stores a provider API key, refusing to save when OS encryption is unavailable unless plaintext is explicitly allowed.

nodes.name: removeProviderKey
nodes.summary: Deletes a provider's stored key and reports whether one existed.

nodes.name: revealProviderKey
nodes.summary: Decrypts and returns a provider's raw API key for HTTPS calls, or null when missing or undecryptable.

nodes.name: hasProviderKey
nodes.summary: Reports whether a usable decrypted key exists for a provider.

nodes.name: readProviderPrefs
nodes.summary: Reads a provider's preferences (default model, base URL override, last success/error) with type-checked defaults.

nodes.name: writeProviderPrefs
nodes.summary: Merges and writes partial provider preferences into ai-provider-prefs.json.

nodes.name: recordProviderSuccess
nodes.summary: Stamps a provider's last success time and clears its last error.

nodes.name: recordProviderError
nodes.summary: Records a truncated last error message and category for a provider.

nodes.name: ProviderError
nodes.summary: Typed provider error carrying provider id, error category, HTTP status and a derived retryable flag.

nodes.name: catalogEntry
nodes.summary: Looks up a provider's catalog entry by id.

nodes.name: isKnownModel
nodes.summary: Checks whether a model id is listed in a provider's catalog (gateway always accepted).

nodes.name: classifyHttpError
nodes.summary: Maps provider HTTP status and body text to a typed ProviderError category (auth, quota, rate limit, unsupported model, server, bad request).

nodes.name: withTimeout
nodes.summary: Creates an AbortSignal that fires on a timeout or when an outer signal aborts, with a cancel function.

nodes.name: postJson
nodes.summary: POSTs JSON to a provider with timeout/abort handling and converts HTTP, timeout, cancellation and network failures into typed ProviderErrors.

nodes.name: openAiChatBody
nodes.summary: Builds an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions body with truncated messages, optional tools, and reasoning params only when the catalog model supports them.

nodes.name: callOpenAiCompatible
nodes.summary: Calls an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint and returns text, usage and latency.

nodes.name: callAnthropic
nodes.summary: Calls the Anthropic messages API with optional tools and thinking budget, parsing text blocks and token usage.

nodes.name: callGemini
nodes.summary: Calls the Gemini generateContent API with key-in-query auth, parsing candidate parts and usageMetadata into a typed response.

nodes.name: generateOnce
nodes.summary: Single provider call without retries: validates key, model and endpoint, then dispatches to the Anthropic, Gemini or OpenAI-compatible adapter.

nodes.name: generateWithRetries
nodes.summary: Retries generateOnce up to 3 times with 300ms/800ms backoff, stopping immediately on non-retryable errors.

nodes.name: generateWithFallback
nodes.summary: Tries each provider candidate in order with retries, returning the first success or throwing the last error.

nodes.name: testConnection
nodes.summary: Genuine low-cost authenticated check making one real model call capped at 64 output tokens.

nodes.name: discoverModels
nodes.summary: Lists a provider's models from its models endpoint (Anthropic, Gemini or OpenAI-style), falling back to the catalog on any failure.

nodes.name: generateStructured
nodes.summary: Requests JSON-only output, strips code fences, parses and validates it against a caller type guard, throwing typed errors on failure.

nodes.name: estimateCost
nodes.summary: Estimates USD cost from catalog pricing and provider token counts, returning null with provenance when pricing is unknown.

nodes.name: defaultRouting
nodes.summary: Builds the default auto routing config, sending strong tasks to the strong default model with a low-cost fallback.

nodes.name: normalizeRouting
nodes.summary: Sanitizes arbitrary routing input into a valid RoutingConfig, clamping tokens, calls, timeouts and budget.

nodes.name: decideRoute
nodes.summary: Pure routing decision returning ordered provider candidates (manual pins or cheapest healthy, plus escalation) or a blocked reason for budget or missing keys.

nodes.name: sdkModelFor
nodes.summary: Creates the matching Vercel AI SDK model object (Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI-compatible) for a provider, rejecting the gateway.

nodes.name: generateTextViaSdk
nodes.summary: Runs Vercel AI SDK generateText for a stored provider credential and maps the result to text and token usage.

nodes.name: usageFilePath
nodes.summary: Returns the path of the ai-usage.jsonl ledger in a data directory.

nodes.name: recordUsage
nodes.summary: Appends one usage record as a JSON line to the usage ledger.

nodes.name: readUsage
nodes.summary: Reads the newest usage records from the JSONL ledger, skipping corrupt lines.

nodes.name: summarizeUsage
nodes.summary: Aggregates usage records into totals, token counts, cost, unknown-pricing count, average latency and per-provider/model/task buckets.

nodes.name: spentThisMonthUsd
nodes.summary: Sums estimated USD for records in the current UTC month, returning null when no priced records exist.

nodes.name: escapeHtml
nodes.summary: Escapes &, <, >, double and single quotes for safe HTML text and attribute values.

nodes.name: scriptLiteral
nodes.summary: Serializes a value as a JSON literal safe to embed in inline script, escaping < and Unicode line separators.

nodes.name: agentDataDir
nodes.summary: Returns the engine data root from AGENT_DATA_DIR or a default folder under the user's home directory.

nodes.name: agentSubdir
nodes.summary: Joins path segments under the engine data root.

nodes.name: ensureAgentDataDir
nodes.summary: Creates the engine data root owner-only (0700) and tightens its permissions on every call.

nodes.name: writeSecretFile
nodes.summary: Writes a secret file with 0700 parent and 0600 file permissions, re-tightening loose permissions best-effort.

nodes.name: admin-config.ts

nodes.name: catalog-image.ts

nodes.name: dates.ts
nodes.summary: Date helpers that normalize marketplace report date columns (ISO, day-month-name, M/D/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY) to YYYY-MM-DD, and compute IST calendar days and Unix-second day windows for OMSGuru daily pulls.

nodes.name: import-profiles.ts
nodes.summary: Declarative header-map profiles for each marketplace return report layout (Myntra, Flipkart, Meesho, Ajio, Amazon): required and optional headers, header aliases and lifecycle date columns, matched by normalized header text rather than column position.

nodes.name: listPartners
nodes.summary: Loads every logistics partner with its aliases and tracking domains in three queries and groups them per partner for the Admin screen.

nodes.name: addPartner
nodes.summary: Adds a logistics partner after cleaning its name, rejects duplicates with a ServiceError, and writes an audit row in the same transaction.

nodes.name: setPartnerActive
nodes.summary: Switches a logistics partner on or off (never deleting it) and audits the change.

nodes.name: addAlias
nodes.summary: Adds a carrier-name alias for a partner, keyed on letters and digits only and optionally scoped to one marketplace, then audits it.

nodes.name: setAliasActive
nodes.summary: Switches a partner alias on or off and audits the change.

nodes.name: addDomain
nodes.summary: Validates and adds a tracking host name for a partner so links on that host identify the carrier; AWB formats remain code-defined. Audited.

nodes.name: publicUrl
nodes.summary: Parses a URL and rejects non-http(s) schemes and loopback, link-local, private-range or internal hosts, guarding the image proxy against SSRF.

nodes.name: fetchUrlFor
nodes.summary: Rewrites Flipkart and Shopify CDN image links to request a small thumbnail size while the stored link stays the original.

nodes.name: storedImage
nodes.summary: Checks that an image URL is already stored in product_master, skus or sku_catalog before it may be fetched.

nodes.name: loadImage
nodes.summary: Returns a cached image from the temp directory or downloads a known stored image with a timeout, size cap and magic-byte type check, then caches it on disk.

nodes.name: sendCatalogImage
nodes.summary: Express handler that validates the requested image URL, coalesces concurrent loads, and streams the cached image with its content type or answers 400/404.

nodes.name: parseReportDate
nodes.summary: Parses a marketplace report date value in any of the observed formats to YYYY-MM-DD, returning an empty string for non-dates and time-only values.

nodes.name: istDayUnixRange
nodes.summary: Returns the Unix-second start and end of an IST (UTC+5:30) calendar day, or null for an invalid day string.

nodes.name: istDay
nodes.summary: Formats a moment as its IST calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD).

nodes.name: istYesterday
nodes.summary: Returns yesterday's IST calendar day, the default window for daily OMSGuru runs.

nodes.name: profileForMarketplace
nodes.summary: Finds the import profile whose marketplace list includes the given account, or null when none matches.

nodes.name: lifecycle.ts
nodes.summary: Counts return lifecycle stages per day from stored upload rows, reading column names from each marketplace's LifecycleConfig and dates through parseReportDate.

nodes.name: logistics.ts

nodes.name: marketplace-rules.ts

nodes.name: catalog.ts

nodes.name: emptyCounts
nodes.summary: Returns a zeroed LifecycleCounts object.

nodes.name: summarizeLifecycle
nodes.summary: Counts each return lifecycle stage for one day (or all days) from stored row data using the marketplace's lifecycle column map and delivered-status text.

nodes.name: loadPartnerIndex
nodes.summary: Queries active partner aliases and tracking domains for a marketplace and builds the in-memory PartnerIndex used by detectPartner.

nodes.summary: Applies detectPartner to every parsed row, records the decision per row and appends a carrier warning only once, so reruns are idempotent.

nodes.name: normalizeHeader
nodes.summary: Normalizes a header name (lowercase, spaces/hyphens/underscores collapsed) so variants of one column name compare equal.

nodes.name: aliasKey
nodes.summary: Reduces a carrier name or alias to lowercase letters and digits for comparison.

nodes.name: marketplaceRank
nodes.summary: Scores how well a product-master row's marketplace scope fits an account (3 exact, 2 generic, 1 all/blank, 0 other account).

nodes.name: returnTypeKey
nodes.summary: Converts a raw return type label to a lowercase underscore code such as courier_return_rto.

nodes.name: normalizeReturnType
nodes.summary: Maps a marketplace's raw return type code to Customer Return, RTO or Replacement Order, keeping unknown codes as written and flagging them.

nodes.name: returnTypeWarning
nodes.summary: Builds the warning text for a return type that did not map, or an empty string when it mapped.

nodes.name: compactSkuKey
nodes.summary: Returns the SKU with all whitespace removed, used as an alternate lookup key.

nodes.name: parentListingSku
nodes.summary: Strips a short non-size article suffix (such as _A) from a listing SKU to get its parent listing.

nodes.name: listingSkuCandidates
nodes.summary: Lists the lookup candidates for a listing SKU: exact, spaceless, and parent listing forms, without duplicates.

nodes.name: isPlaceholderMasterSku
nodes.summary: Detects dummy or parking master SKU codes (B16, KD2, D6, D12, INACTIVE*, NA, NULL and similar) that must never shadow a real product SKU.

nodes.name: normalizeMasterMarketplace
nodes.summary: Normalizes a marketplace or OMSGuru channel label to the lowercase scope stored in product_master (myntra vb, amazon, all and so on).

nodes.name: isVerifiedTrackingHost
nodes.summary: Checks whether a host is one of the carrier tracking hosts with a verified link format.

nodes.name: hostOf
nodes.summary: Extracts the lowercase host name from a URL, or an empty string when it cannot be parsed.

nodes.name: parseTrackingLink
nodes.summary: Reads the carrier and AWB from an https tracking link on a verified host in a verified format, returning a typed failure reason otherwise.

nodes.name: awbFromTrackingUrl
nodes.summary: Compatibility wrapper returning only the host and AWB of a verified tracking link, or null.

nodes.name: roundToFifteenDigits
nodes.summary: Rounds a 16-digit AWB to 15 significant digits the way a spreadsheet does, to detect Excel-rounded values.

nodes.name: truncateToFifteenDigits
nodes.summary: Zeroes digits beyond the 15th, reproducing Excel truncation of long numeric AWBs.

nodes.name: matchesScientificAwb
nodes.summary: Checks whether an Excel scientific-notation value (for example 1.49071E+15) matches the magnitude and leading digits of a full AWB.

nodes.name: resolveTrackingId
nodes.summary: Decides the AWB of one Meesho row: keeps the CSV value unless a verified carrier link confirms it through exact, truncated, rounded or scientific-notation matching, flagging damaged or unverified identifiers.

nodes.name: aliasHit
nodes.summary: Finds the partner for a carrier key by exact scoped alias, exact global alias, then the longest alias stem the key starts with (scoped preferred).

nodes.name: detectPartner
nodes.summary: Resolves a row's written carrier name to a verified logistics partner via the alias index, or returns Unknown / Pending Verification with an Admin warning; never guesses from the AWB shape.

nodes.name: catalogEntry
nodes.summary: Builds a sku_catalog entry from an OMSGuru listing row when it has a SKU and at least a title or image.

nodes.name: listingRecord
nodes.summary: Maps an OMSGuru listing row to a ListingRecord with ids, SKU, master SKU id, prices, title and image; null when it has no id.

nodes.name: storeListingRecords
nodes.summary: Upserts one page of listing records into oms_listings in batches, de-duplicating by id and counting inserts versus updates via xmax.

nodes.name: storeCatalogPage
nodes.summary: Upserts one page of listings into sku_catalog keyed by normalized SKU, never overwriting a stored title or image with a blank.

nodes.name: storeListingPage
nodes.summary: Writes one page of listings to both oms_listings and sku_catalog and returns the page counts.

nodes.name: syncChannelListings
nodes.summary: Pages through one channel's OMSGuru listings with the last_id cursor, handing each page to a callback until a short page ends the sync.

nodes.name: client.ts
nodes.summary: OMSGuru API client: environment-based configuration, rate-limit pacing via X-OMS-Remaining, throttle and 5xx retry with backoff, response-envelope parsing, and normalization helpers for listing SKU, title, image, id and money fields.
nodes.languageNotes: OmsClient takes injectable fetch and sleep implementations through constructor parameter properties, which makes the retry and pacing logic testable without network access.

nodes.name: invoices.ts
nodes.summary: Daily OMSGuru invoice pull for one IST day, paged by last_id: normalizes tracking numbers, builds stable invoice keys and upserts redacted invoice rows, plus oms_sync_runs bookkeeping through startRun and finishRun.

nodes.name: master-bridge.ts
nodes.summary: Nightly bridge from synced OMSGuru listings to product_master, run in one transaction: inserts new mappings, fills blank images, and flips resolved unmapped listing SKUs. Channels that do not map to exactly one account (for example anything Myntra) are skipped and counted.

nodes.name: orders.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes OMSGuru order-detail response rows, strips buyer personal data before storage, and stores order snapshots and lookup outcomes (NOT_FOUND or error) so repeated runs skip them.

nodes.name: OmsError
nodes.summary: Base error class for OMSGuru API failures.

nodes.name: OmsThrottled
nodes.summary: OmsError subclass raised when the OMSGuru shared rate limit is still exhausted after retries.

nodes.name: OmsClient
nodes.summary: OMSGuru HTTP client that sends authenticated form/query requests with retry for network errors, 5xx and 429/throttle bodies, paces on remaining credits, and exposes channel, warehouse, listing, SKU and order-detail calls.

nodes.name: omsConfigFromEnv
nodes.summary: Reads the OMSGuru base URL, API token and client id from environment variables, defaulting the base URL.

nodes.name: rowsFrom
nodes.summary: Extracts rows from an OMSGuru response that is a bare array or an { error, message, data } envelope, treating 'no ... found' errors as empty lists.

nodes.name: isThrottleBody
nodes.summary: Detects a small 200 response whose error code -4 signals the shared rate limit was hit.

nodes.name: normalizeSkuKey
nodes.summary: Uppercases a SKU and collapses whitespace so every SKU join matches consistently.

nodes.name: normalizeImageUrl
nodes.summary: Keeps only absolute http(s) image links, upgrading protocol-relative links to https.

nodes.name: firstText
nodes.summary: Returns the first non-empty value among several row keys as text.

nodes.name: moneyOrNull
nodes.summary: Parses a price or cost to a non-negative number rounded to two decimals, or null.

nodes.name: listingSku
nodes.summary: Reads the listing SKU from an OMSGuru listing row in Forward Scan priority order.

nodes.name: listingImage
nodes.summary: Reads and normalizes the image URL from an OMSGuru listing row.

nodes.name: listingTitle
nodes.summary: Reads the listing title from an OMSGuru listing row.

nodes.name: listingId
nodes.summary: Reads the numeric listing id from an OMSGuru listing row, or null.

nodes.name: remainingCredits
nodes.summary: Reads the rate-limit credits left from the X-OMS-Remaining response header, or null when absent.

nodes.name: normalizeTracking
nodes.summary: Uppercases a tracking number, removes courier suffixes in parentheses, and keeps only letters, digits and - _ /.

nodes.name: invoiceKey
nodes.summary: Builds a stable key for an invoice row from channel, order id, invoice or sub-order ids, and normalized tracking, so re-pulls update in place.

nodes.name: storeInvoiceRows
nodes.summary: Normalizes and upserts OMSGuru invoice rows with their IST day and a personal-data-redacted raw payload.

nodes.name: syncInvoicesForDay
nodes.summary: Pulls every invoice page for one IST day window via the OMSGuru client with last_id paging, passing each page to a callback.

nodes.name: startRun
nodes.summary: Inserts an oms_sync_runs row for a sync kind and day and returns its id.

nodes.name: finishRun
nodes.summary: Marks an oms_sync_runs row done, throttled or errored with page and row counts.

nodes.name: marketplaceForChannel
nodes.summary: Maps an OMSGuru channel label to exactly one account name by whole-word match, returning null for Myntra (ambiguous VB/EJ) and unknown channels.

nodes.name: bridgeMasterMappings
nodes.summary: In one transaction inserts new product_master mappings from mapped OMSGuru listings, fills blank images, pastes product-SKU images, and flips resolved unmapped listing SKUs; rolls back on error.

nodes.name: redactPersonalData
nodes.summary: Recursively removes buyer and contact fields from an OMSGuru response before it is stored.

nodes.name: normalizeOrderRow
nodes.summary: Maps an OMSGuru order row to a NormalizedOrder with channel order id, sub-order ids, item statuses, SKUs, tracker, invoice and warehouse fields.

nodes.name: usableLookupKey
nodes.summary: Cleans a stored return key into an order lookup key, stripping Excel wrappers and rejecting values already damaged by scientific notation.

nodes.name: hasSnapshot
nodes.summary: Checks whether an order snapshot already exists for a lookup type and key.

nodes.name: storeOrderRows
nodes.summary: Upserts every order row OMSGuru returned for one lookup into oms_order_snapshots with a redacted raw payload.

nodes.name: recordLookupOutcome
nodes.summary: Stores a NOT_FOUND or error outcome for a lookup so later runs do not repeat it.

nodes.name: skus.ts
nodes.summary: Syncs the OMSGuru master SKU list into oms_skus, paging with the last_id cursor and reporting stored versus newly inserted SKUs.

nodes.name: product-master.ts
nodes.summary: Core product master service: candidate-aware unmapped listing SKU resolution, audited merge or replace loads, image inheritance across listings of one product SKU, unmapped SKU queue reporting and CSV template, staged 500-row batch imports, and nightly auto-resolution through OMSGuru and VMS.

nodes.name: audit-deep.ts
nodes.summary: Ad-hoc audit script that parses local Amazon and Meesho sample return files and prints blank reverse-tracking statistics, return-type and status counts, and tracking-link host to carrier breakdowns.

nodes.name: audit-files.ts
nodes.summary: CLI audit script that parses each marketplace's sample return file and prints the upload preview counts, activation blockers, confirmations needed, and sample invalid, pending and warning rows.

nodes.name: skuRecord
nodes.summary: Maps an OMSGuru master SKU row to a SkuRecord with SKU code, name, prices, size/style/model/color codes and UPC; null when it has no id.

nodes.name: storeSkuPage
nodes.summary: Upserts one page of master SKUs into oms_skus in batches, reporting stored and newly inserted counts via xmax.

nodes.name: syncSkuMaster
nodes.summary: Pages through the whole OMSGuru master SKU list with last_id, stopping on an empty page or a cursor that does not move.

nodes.name: unmappedIsResolved
nodes.summary: Decides whether an unmapped listing SKU now resolves: any candidate form hits a stored master key for the same account, the all/blank scope, or a generic scope ranked by marketplaceRank.

nodes.name: loadMasterLookupKeys
nodes.summary: Loads every non-placeholder product_master listing and expands its SKU candidates into a marketplace|key set for fast resolution checks.

nodes.name: flipResolvedUnmappedRows
nodes.summary: Marks unmapped_listing_skus rows as mapped when unmappedIsResolved says a master mapping now covers them, using a set-based LOWER() update.

nodes.name: productMasterState
nodes.summary: Read-only summary of the product master for the Admin screen: row, listing and product SKU counts, image coverage, per-account row counts, last load time and sample rows.

nodes.name: masterSkuKey
nodes.summary: Normalizes a product SKU (trimmed, lowercase) as the key for sharing one image across listings.

nodes.name: inheritBlankMasterImages
nodes.summary: Fills blank image links from another row of the same product SKU, preferring links in the file over stored ones and never replacing an existing link.

nodes.name: inheritedImageCount
nodes.summary: Counts how many rows gained an image link between the before and after row lists.

nodes.name: loadStoredMasterImages
nodes.summary: Loads the newest non-blank stored image for each product SKU in a list.

nodes.name: pasteBlankMasterImages
nodes.summary: Writes a known product-SKU image onto product_master rows that are still blank, optionally limited to given SKUs; saved images are never replaced.

nodes.name: upsertProductMaster
nodes.summary: Merges product master rows in chunks on (marketplace, listing_sku) without deleting existing data, fills blank images, flips resolved unmapped SKUs, syncs register master SKUs and audits the load.

nodes.name: replaceProductMaster
nodes.summary: Replaces the whole product master from one file in a single transaction, keeping the previous master on failure, then syncs register master SKUs and audits the change.

nodes.name: recordUnmappedListingSkus
nodes.summary: Upserts listing SKUs that had no master mapping into the unmapped_listing_skus queue with sample order and tracking ids.

nodes.name: getUnmappedListingSkusSummary
nodes.summary: Summarizes the unmapped listing SKU queue: totals, per-marketplace counts and recent samples.

nodes.name: listUnmappedListingSkus
nodes.summary: Lists unmapped listing SKUs with marketplace, status and search filters plus clamped pagination.

nodes.name: refreshUnmappedListingSkus
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the unmapped listing SKU queue from expected return items whose listing SKU has no product master mapping (after candidate-aware filtering), and returns the number recorded.

nodes.name: generateUnmappedSkusTemplateCsv
nodes.summary: Produces a CSV template of pending unmapped listing SKUs, optionally for one marketplace, for operators to fill with product SKUs.

nodes.name: clampMasterBatchLimit
nodes.summary: Caps a client-supplied batch size at 500, treating missing or invalid values as 500.

nodes.name: takeMasterBatch
nodes.summary: Returns the next chunk of staged master rows to commit and the progress it leads to.

nodes.name: masterBatchProgress
nodes.summary: Computes overall staged import progress with processed rows clamped to the total.

nodes.name: requireStagedMasterImport
nodes.summary: Returns the staged master import for its owner or throws ServiceError for unknown, foreign or expired staging ids, evicting expired entries.

nodes.name: upsertMasterRows
nodes.summary: Upserts one chunk of master rows in merge mode inside a caller-owned transaction.

nodes.name: insertMasterRows
nodes.summary: Inserts one chunk of master rows in replace mode inside a caller-owned transaction.

nodes.name: markUnmappedListingSkusMapped
nodes.summary: Shared entry point that flips matching unmapped listing SKUs to mapped using candidate-aware resolution.

nodes.name: autoResolveMissingListingSkus
nodes.summary: Nightly or on-demand auto-linking of missing listing SKUs: runs the OMSGuru master bridge, applies the VMS catalogue when configured, syncs register master SKUs, and reports what was resolved.

nodes.name: auditAmazon
nodes.summary: Parses the local Amazon sample return file and prints blank reverse-tracking counts, return-type and status tallies, and sample rows.

nodes.name: auditMeesho
nodes.summary: Parses the local Meesho sample return file and prints tracking-link hosts with the carriers seen on each.

nodes.name: diagnose-file.ts
nodes.summary: Read-only CLI diagnostic that runs a real marketplace file through inspectLayout and parseSpreadsheet and prints the same counts and warning samples an upload preview would show, without touching the database.

nodes.name: fetch-oms-orders.ts
nodes.summary: CLI that fetches OMSGuru order details for return rows already stored in the app (sub_order_id first, then order_id), saves snapshots, records misses, optionally writes a CSV report, and stops on a throttled answer.

nodes.name: inspect-layout.ts
nodes.summary: CLI that checks a marketplace export against its header profile with inspectLayout, printing the detected profile, normalized headers, missing required headers and a masked first data row. Nothing is written to the database.

nodes.name: load-product-master.ts
nodes.summary: CLI that loads the VB EXPORT product master workbook into product_master, replacing the table in one transaction while inheriting blank image links from rows of the same product SKU and reporting SKU conflicts.

nodes.name: printFieldNames
nodes.summary: Prints the sorted top-level and item field names of the first OMSGuru order response so field mappings can be checked without printing values.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses CLI options, selects stored returns, skips existing snapshots, looks up order details with delays, stores rows or outcomes, stops on throttling, and writes an optional CSV report.

nodes.name: readArgs
nodes.summary: Reads the file path (first non-flag argument) and optional --marketplace value from argv in any order.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses the product master workbook, checks the schema, inherits images, replaces product_master in 1000-row chunks inside one transaction, pastes images, and prints load and conflict statistics.

nodes.name: report-returns.ts
nodes.summary: CLI script (npm run report:returns) that prints a daily return report straight from the database: latest marketplace upload lifecycle counts, receipt scans per IST day, OMSGuru invoice dispatches and an AWB cross-check, optionally writing CSV files to exports.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses --date/--csv flags, queries uploads, scans and OMSGuru invoices, summarizes lifecycle stages per marketplace profile and prints (and optionally exports) the four report sections.

nodes.name: sync-oms-catalog.ts
nodes.summary: Daily OMSGuru catalogue sync script (npm run sync:oms) that pulls channel listings and the master SKU list into oms_listings, oms_skus and sku_catalog, then runs the product-master bridge, logging each step in oms_sync_runs.
nodes.languageNotes: Credentials are read from environment variables by key name only; the script never prints their values.

nodes.name: closeRun
nodes.summary: Marks an oms_sync_runs row finished with its ok flag, step counts and a trimmed error message.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the OMSGuru pull: lists channels (--list), syncs listings for every active channel or one --channel, then the master SKU list and the product-master bridge unless skipped, recording each run.

nodes.name: sync-oms-daily.ts
nodes.summary: Daily OMSGuru invoice pull script (npm run oms:daily) that stores dispatched shipments with AWBs for every channel one IST day at a time, for yesterday, one date or an inclusive range, stopping cleanly when throttled.

nodes.name: daysBetween
nodes.summary: Expands an inclusive from/to date pair into the list of ISO calendar days between them.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Resolves the requested day range, opens an oms_sync_runs record per day, syncs invoices through the OMSGuru client and finishes the run as ok, throttled or failed.

nodes.name: sync-vms-catalog.ts
nodes.summary: CLI script (npm run sync:vms-catalog) that reads the external VMS catalogue strictly read-only and merges listing-to-master SKU mappings and blank image links into the local product_master, with help, CA pinning, probe, dry-run and apply modes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dynamic import() for the local database pool and the dry-run/apply functions so --help, --probe and --fetch-ca never open the local database.

nodes.name: printHelp
nodes.summary: Prints the usage text describing the read-only VMS sync modes without connecting to anything.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Dispatches on the CLI flag: pins the VMS certificate, probes the schema, prints a masked sample, or runs a dry-run/apply against the local pool, always closing the VMS pool afterwards.

nodes.name: sheets.ts

nodes.languageNotes: Uses BigInt to write whole numbers in full and a hand-written RFC 4180 CSV reader so identifiers never pass through floating-point coercion.

nodes.name: rowStatus
nodes.summary: Derives a parsed row's status (error, pending, cancelled or valid) from its errors, pending reasons and return type.

nodes.name: isScannableRow
nodes.summary: True when a parsed row has a valid status and can become active lookup data for scanning.

nodes.name: parseSpreadsheet
nodes.summary: Main entry point for a return report: reads the grid, finds the profile header, rejects wrong-seller files, maps each row with its profile mapper, attaches raw data and fingerprints, and flags repeats.

nodes.name: inspectLayout
nodes.summary: Lists the detected header row and first sample rows of a file for checking a layout against a real export, storing nothing.

nodes.name: parseProductMaster
nodes.summary: Parses the product master file (two known layouts matched by header name) into channel listing SKU to product SKU rows with category and image, rejecting placeholder SKUs and normalizing marketplace scope.

nodes.name: summarizeProductMaster
nodes.summary: Counts listings, distinct product SKUs, images and marketplace scopes in parsed product master rows without touching the database.

nodes.name: masterPreviewForRows
nodes.summary: Builds the Admin preview summary and sample rows for a parsed product master, optionally after blank images were inherited.

nodes.name: previewProductMaster
nodes.summary: Single Admin preview entry point that parses a product master file and summarizes it.

nodes.name: templateCsv
nodes.summary: Returns the header-only return-report CSV template with no sample data.

nodes.name: productMasterTemplateCsv
nodes.summary: Returns the header-only product master CSV template so an unchanged copy imports nothing.

nodes.name: parseCsv
nodes.summary: Minimal RFC 4180 CSV reader that keeps every field as text, supporting quoted commas and line breaks so leading zeros survive.

nodes.name: readGrid
nodes.summary: Reads a CSV or XLSX buffer into a text grid, writing whole numbers in full and marking untrusted numeric cells.

nodes.name: usableGrid
nodes.summary: Filters a grid down to rows that contain at least one non-empty cell.

nodes.name: locateHeader
nodes.summary: Finds the header row among the first 40 usable rows by counting required header names, reporting which are missing.

nodes.name: toFields
nodes.summary: Converts data rows below the header into normalized field maps keyed by header name, applying aliases and suspect-column tracking.

nodes.name: readId
nodes.summary: Reads an identifier cell under trust rules: scientific or over-precision values are refused, made pending or warned depending on whether the value is the lookup key.

nodes.name: parseQuantity
nodes.summary: Validates that a quantity is a whole number of at least 1, optionally treating zero as pending; never guesses.

nodes.name: baseRow
nodes.summary: Creates a ParsedRow with neutral defaults for every field so each marketplace mapper sets only what its file provides.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Fills the common derived fields (errors, warnings, pending reasons, status) once a mapper has populated a row.

nodes.name: genericRow
nodes.summary: Maps a row from a generic return layout, reading tracking, order and SKU identifiers and normalizing return type without inventing descriptive fields.

nodes.name: myntraRow

nodes.name: flipkartRow
nodes.summary: Maps a Flipkart return row, reading tracking and order item IDs under trust rules and normalizing customer/courier return codes.

nodes.name: meeshoRow
nodes.summary: Maps a Meesho return row, verifying the AWB against the carrier tracking link (15-digit rounding repair) and combining SKU with variation.

nodes.name: ajioRow
nodes.summary: Maps an Ajio return row with Return AWB as lookup key, JioCode SKU and the return order number as a display identifier.

nodes.name: amazonRow
nodes.summary: Maps an Amazon return row using the reverse-leg tracking ID as lookup AWB, keeping forward leg, RMA and shipment IDs for audit only.

nodes.name: mapRow
nodes.summary: Dispatches a field map to the marketplace-specific mapper selected by the import profile.

nodes.name: flagRepeats
nodes.summary: Classifies repeats within a file as exact duplicates, repeated lines or repeated return events, never merging by AWB alone.

nodes.name: sellerProblem
nodes.summary: Checks the file's seller or supplier block against the selected marketplace account and returns a rejection reason when it differs.

nodes.name: data-capture.test.ts
